newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIETUMU BANK FIRST QUARTER PROFIT 2.29 MLN LATS.
newsitem.headline: RIETUMU BANK FIRST QUARTER PROFIT 2.29 MLN LATS.

text.p: Latvian bank Rietumu Bank said on Monday that its first quarter profit was 2.29 million lats.
The bank said in statement that its assets rose in the first quarter by 9.39 million lats to 97.62 million lats.
It added that bank and clients' securities in its balance sheet rose from 31.8 million lats to 40.48 million lats.
Deposits in the bank were 48.29 million lats, the bank's own capital rose from 9.1 million lats at the end of 1996 to 11.39 million lats at the end of the first quarter.
It also said that its client base rose by 876 people to reach 15,000 clients.
